title: Runtime state defaults to the outer project's ignored .pi/, with an explicit external mode
statement: Session transcripts live under `<project>/.pi/sessions/` and launch, consent, compatibility and transaction records under `<project>/.pi/runtime/`, both covered by Kiln's marked `.gitignore` block and neither written before that coverage exists. `.pi/settings.json` and `.pi/kiln.json` are deliberately not ignored: they are reproducible, non-secret project configuration and should be reviewable in a diff. An explicit external mode relocates the two ignored directories to a per-user root keyed by the committed project ID, and exists only if the pinned runtime supports it.
rationale: Two locations are excluded for different reasons. Inside the tool clone is wrong because `git pull` on `.planning/` is the update channel and may destroy anything there. Tracked inside the outer project is wrong because transcripts and consent records are host-specific and sometimes sensitive. What is left is an ignored directory in the outer project, which is also where Pi already expects project-local runtime state to live.

alternatives.option: Under .planning/, as the original decision #29 said
alternatives.whyNot: Dirties the clone that the update channel replaces. Tool state is not permission to write runtime data into the tool's own source checkout.

alternatives.option: Always external, under a per-user state root
alternatives.whyNot: Removes the simple case for no benefit most operators would notice, and makes the common path depend on a Pi capability that has not been proved to exist.
Would hide the package entry, the skill-override path and the model selection — the reproducible configuration that most deserves to be reviewed in a diff.

notes: ⚠️ THIS IS THE GRAPH RECORD OF THE AMENDMENT ALREADY MADE TO CANONICAL DECISION #29 AND #71 on 2026-09-02. Those rows and the layout diagram in the notes were updated in the same change, so only one answer is live. ⚠️ COVERAGE BEFORE DATA IS THE OPERATIONAL RULE: if the marked block is missing or was deliberately edited, setup offers the external mode or stops, and never writes a transcript into a path Git is tracking.
